mapper.insert: insert into clazz (name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject,create_time,update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{subject},#{createTime},#{updateTime});
mapper.update:
update clazz
name = #{name},
room = #{room},
begin_date = #{beginDate},
end_date = #{endDate},
master_id = #{masterId},
subject = #{subject},
update_time = #{updateTime}
where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select c.id, c.name, c.room, c.begin_date beginDate, c.end_date endDate, c.master_id masterId, c.create_time createTime, c.update_time updateTime, e.name masterName, (case when c.begin_date < CURDATE() then '已开班' else '未开班' end) status from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id = e.id
c.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and c.begin_date between #{begin} and #{end}
order by c.update_time desc
